scope: Public documents only; no datasets, model fits, credentials, paid services or API calls.
procedure: Retrieve the fixed-version HTML URL first using urllib without credentials and with automatic redirects disabled.

If the first attempt fails or lacks the expected document format/title markers, preserve its record and any partial bytes; then try the declared PDF fallback, or retry the official documentation URL once.
Charge actual payload bytes toward source and total caps, including retained failed payloads. Stop before exceeding a cap; never retry to bypass it.

Use exclusive output filenames and retain every attempted acquisition record. Record URL, attempt, retrieval time, status, payload bytes, relative path, SHA-256, version, locator and verification limits.
For successful HTML require an HTML format marker and declared title/content markers; for PDF require the PDF signature. Format checks do not establish full-text scientific approval.
No claim about method assumptions is promoted solely because a full-text snapshot was downloaded. Unavailable documents remain explicitly unavailable.
